focus.name: player-collision-animation-prelude-static
focus.purpose: Recover the generic player animation range selected directly by the player collision pass and bind its exact branch and state-selector behavior.

selection.guard: The assignment is the default collision-response prelude; PLAYER_ANIM_LANDING_RESPONSE_SPAWN is selected when PLAYER_ANIMATION_FIELD_B0 is clear, while PLAYER_ANIM_LANDING_RECOVERY may replace it for the additional state gate.

decoded: F4 compare PLAYER_ANIMATION_FIELD_B0 against zero and branch to 0x00122080

conclusion: The formerly generic 0x001220AA-0x001220B7 animation range is a player collision-response prelude directly selected by Actor_PlayerCollisionPass, not an unclassified stream fragment.
